s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly enlarging, firm, painless mass in the left labia majora with a long history of recurrence
salient_findings: Slowly enlarging mass in the left labia majora over 10 years
Mass is firm, painless, and immobile
History of multiple recurrences after excision
Imaging shows a heterogeneous, hypervascular subcutaneous mass
key_facts: 64-year-old woman
Mass in the left labia majora
Mass is approximately 7 × 4 cm
Normal vital signs
Normal routine laboratory tests
History of excised mass in the Bartholin’s gland
Histopathology showed chondroid syringoma
Recurrence in the labia majora with histology showing clear cell hidradenoma
Ultrasound showed a 4.2 × 8 cm heterogeneous, hypervascular subcutaneous mass
CT scan demonstrated a 3.8 × 7.2 cm heterogeneous, contrast-enhancing lesion
Low-density focus in the liver suggestive of a simple cyst
Vulvar mass was excised and reported as chondroid syringoma
Recurrence near the fourchette three months after excision
